_note: What's new pop-up in the terminal. Add the newest release at the top. tier is free, premium, pro or lens. cat (optional) is the access key used for the Unlock button. link is relative to the site root.

items.title: Whale Moves
items.blurb: Big wallets and top Hyperliquid traders: who is long or short, what they just opened or closed, and the largest recent on-chain transfers.

items.title: Pair Risk
items.blurb: The TTM Risk Metric for pairs like ETH/BTC, so you can see when a coin is cheap or stretched against Bitcoin, not just against the dollar.

items.title: TTM Risk Metric
items.blurb: One 0 to 1 reading of where Bitcoin sits in its cycle, blue when cheap through to red when stretched, with how markets have behaved in each risk zone.

items.title: Cycle Overlay
items.blurb: This cycle laid over the 2013, 2017 and 2021 cycles, from each top and from each halving. Switch any cycle on or off to compare.

items.title: Stablecoins and Dominance
items.blurb: Stablecoin supply, USDT and USDC dominance, and Bitcoin and altcoin dominance over time, to see where money is sitting and where it is moving.

items.title: TTM Pills for stocks
items.blurb: Top US and ASX stocks as live pills, sized by the move. Gainers on top, losers at the bottom. US prices are near-live; ASX is delayed 20 minutes by the exchange.

items.title: TradFi Risk Charts
items.blurb: Liquidity, credit spreads, the yield curve, jobs, production, GDP and VIX, each scored for risk. Now open to Premium members.

items.title: TTM Pills
items.blurb: Every crypto coin as a live pill. The biggest gainers sit on top and the biggest losers at the bottom. Click any pill for its price, every time window and a link to the chart. Works as an app on your phone too.

items.title: Market Makers tracker
items.blurb: Wintermute and other big market makers: are they long or short on BTC, ETH, XRP and SOL, plus their big wallet moves.

items.title: Exchange holidays in Trading Hours
items.blurb: Closures and early closes for crypto and TradFi sessions, with the reason, upcoming tiles and a mention in the daily brief.

items.title: TTM LENS
items.blurb: Full-screen live charts with drawing tools, indicators and replay. Anyone can buy a LENS pass, even on the free plan. Click any ticker to open it.

items.title: Hedge in the trade tracker
items.blurb: You can now hold a long and a short on the same coin at the same time.
